entries.source: ReplayKit headers of the macOS 27.0 SDK
entries.reason: the recording itself is the next slice: the app's windows rendered into an H.264 movie through the release's AVAssetWriter; this slice carries the recorder's state and answers without it
entries.effect: nothing: the selector is not carried, so a call from an application that does not check availability is an unrecognized selector; no recording starts
